reviews.title: Asus Rog Glass Pad is Amazing!
reviews.comment: This has to be probably my favorite Mouse Pad! Switching to a glass pad was the best thing i have ever done. Easy to clean, i couldnt stand fabric pads because dust gets embedded into it and even after cleaning i can still see residue on the pads. The glass pads changed the game! This product feels very premium and not cheap. also has some slight friction not crazy slippery.
reviews.author: Da Northwest

reviews.title: Finally upgraded and wow, this mousepad is something else
reviews.comment: I've been using basic cloth/plastic pads for years and decided to treat myself to the Moonstone ACE L. Right out of the box, you can tell ASUS put effort into the presentation. The packaging feels premium and protective, not just thrown together. The pad itself looks fantastic on my desk. The tempered glass surface has this clean, almost futuristic appearance that matches my setup perfectly. What really surprised me is the surface texture. It's incredibly smooth when you glide your mouse across it, but there's this subtle texture you can feel if you run your hand over it. It's hard to explain, but it gives just enough feedback without any drag. Tracking is precise and consistent across the entire surface. No dead spots or weird areas like I've had with some other pads. My mouse sensor seems to love it. Cleaning is ridiculously easy compared to cloth pads. A quick wipe with a microfiber cloth and it looks brand new again. No worrying about spills either since nothing soaks in. I spilled some water on it the first week and just wiped it off in two seconds. The size is generous without taking over my whole desk. My only tiny complaint is that it's heavy, but that also means it stays put and doesn't slide around during intense gaming sessions. Worth the price if you want something that performs well and looks great doing it.
reviews.author: Steven Zimmerman

reviews.title: ASUS glass mousepad, nothing to envy other brands. Excelente mousepad de Cristal.
reviews.comment: Quede encantado con esta compra, se siente la calidad del material, nada que envidiarle a otras marcas. Para gaming o uso en general si quieres dejar de usar mousepad de tela, cambia al de cristal. Vas a necesitar los skate para tu mouse, en calidad precio es buena opción, recomiendo usar con mouse ligeros, algunos mouse son pesados no dejaran disfrutar este mousepad como se debe, la base no es tan resbaladiza como dicen, hay que hacerle mucha fuerza para moverlo porque usando el mouse se puede mover pero casi no se nota. I was delighted with this purchase, you can feel the quality of the material, nothing to envy other brands. For gaming or general use, if you want to stop using a cloth mousepad, switch to a glass mousepad. You are going to need the skates for your mouse, in terms of quality and price it is a good option, I recommend using it with light mice, some mice are heavy and will not allow you to enjoy this mousepad as you should, the base is not as slippery as they say, you have to use a lot of force to move it because using the mouse it can move but it is almost not noticeable.
reviews.author: YoungSteel

reviews.comment: Really smooth. And grips the table really well. Even though I have a slippery top it’s still fine. The quality of the glass just 10000000/5

reviews.title: Best Mousepad I had
reviews.comment: I have a lot of Asus stuff, so I decided to get to match with it all, and I had the Razer Goliath mousepad, and it was just a pain to clean, heard about glass mousepad and decided to try and it is way better than regular mousepad, I don't have the lightest mouse since I play a lot of MMO, but with this I barely feel the weight when moving it, and it's so easy to clean since it's glass, never going back to regular mousepads
